messages:
Ava Chen: Quick sync — MuseBridge case study window? We told them we'd record week of Apr 12.
Ben Ortiz: I can book Apr 13 10am PT. Do we need legal to pre-approve the quote before sending? @Legal-Bot
Legal-Bot: Legal review required: case_study_musebridge_draft_v3.pdf uploaded to Drive (folder: /Marketing/CaseStudies/MuseBridge). Ticket LR-732 created.
Clara Nguyen: I'll send the draft to them for factual check, but legal flagged the phrase 'proprietary throughput' — they'll want that softened.
Emily Park: Also confirm benchmark chart source. We switched baseline to Q4 2025 for consistency with the new leaderboard. Ask them to approve the chart too.
Sam Rios: For the webinar tie-in — plan is 10-min product demo + 15-min customer panel + 10-min Q&A. Need to decide moderator.
Ben Ortiz: Sounds good. Moderation candidate: Emily or Sam. Also set UTM parameters: ?utm_campaign=musebridge-case-2026 and route hot leads to SDR queue. @sales
Jules Martin: I queued quote redlines. Legal prefers we replace raw revenue numbers with qualitative "business impact" language unless customer authorizes specifics.
Tom Becker: Recording logistics: remote via Zoom, record separate tracks, request a high-res logo and headshot from Paul, and ask for the customer's one-sentence bio.
Ava Chen: I'll update the Asana checklist: interview brief, recording slot, legal review, production edit (48h), AE enablement pack. Tagging @production for edit turnaround. :thumbsup:
Paul Kwan (MuseBridge): (external) Happy to do Apr 13. We can send logo + headshot. Can you share the draft quote first?
Clara Nguyen: Sending the draft now (Drive link). Please review the benchmark figure and the highlighted quote — we kept it to one sentence.
Paul Kwan (MuseBridge): Got it. We'll review and get back by Monday.
Emily Park: Embargo proposal: publish 2026-04-20, webinar 2026-04-22. Can we lock those dates?
Ben Ortiz: Locking dates. Who owns final copy approval? @marketing-leads
Jules Martin: Final sign-off flow: marketing (Ava) approves after legal clears; then customer PM signs off on final quote.
Ava Chen: Agreed. Legal-Bot — any ETA on LR-732?
Legal-Bot: LR-732 ETA 48 hours. Priority: high.
Sam Rios: Lead routing: set form to tag intent (pilot/buy) and route pilot/buy to SDR hot queue, others to nurture. Also add a Sales enablement asset: benchmark appendix PDF.
Ben Ortiz: I'll add the appendix to the sales folder and link in the case study. Filename: musebridge-benchmark-appendix-v1.pdf
Clara Nguyen: Noted. I'll upload final assets to /Marketing/CaseStudies/MuseBridge/assets once legal signs off.
Emily Park: Reminder to keep customer quotes concise (1-2 lines) and avoid firm numeric claims unless explicitly authorized.
Tom Becker: On recording day: please provide participant dial-in details, ask Paul to join 10 minutes early for mic check, and enable separate audio tracks. Also capture customer screenshots if available.
Ava Chen: Wrapping up — I'll send a finalized timeline and checklist in Asana, tag everyone, and follow up with the customer for logos. Thanks all. :rocket:
